name: Crescent Blade Training
body:
You are adept at wielding the elven crescent blade, which grants you added use for the weapon.

Prerequisites: Proficiency with the elven crescent blade, elf.

Benefit: Elven cresent blades you wield gain the disarm and trip properties. These only apply when you attack with the weapon in melee.
